purpose: Part 4/4 of verified dynamic 100-record item effect batch 011; together these files contain exactly 100 self-contained reviewed records.

items/murlynds-spoon.name: Murlynd's Spoon
items/murlynds-spoon.effectSummary: Placed in an empty container, the spoon produces a nutritious but bland gruel. It can create enough food each day to sustain up to four humans and can nourish herbivorous, omnivorous, or carnivorous creatures.

items/shield-spikes-598.name: Shield Spikes
items/shield-spikes-598.effectSummary: Adding spikes turns a shield into a martial piercing weapon and increases shield-bash damage as though the shield were one size category larger. Bucklers and tower shields cannot be spiked, and the shield's armor enhancement bonus does not improve bash attacks, though the spikes can be separately enchanted as a weapon.

items/shoes-of-farstriding.name: Shoes of Farstriding
items/shoes-of-farstriding.effectSummary: The shoes grant +10 feet enhancement to base land speed, +4 on checks to resist bull rushes, trips, or other forced movement, and +2 enhancement to Constitution.

items/amulet-wordtwisting-521.name: Amulet of Wordtwisting
items/amulet-wordtwisting-521.effectSummary: The amulet grants +2 insight on Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive, increased to +4 for an orc wearer. Once per day it can also grant tongues to the wearer.

items/deepdweller-28.name: Deepdweller
items/deepdweller-28.effectSummary: The armor grants water breathing, immunity to cold-water and deep-pressure damage, removes its armor check penalty from Swim checks, allows speech with any water-breathing creature that has a language, and doubles normal underwater sight distance.

items/glitter-stone-406.name: Glitter Stone
items/glitter-stone-406.effectSummary: Thrown or slung as a ranged touch attack, the stone bursts in a 10-foot radius without dealing damage. Invisible creatures in the area become visible and take -40 on Hide checks for 3 rounds.

items/lenses-of-clarity.name: Lenses of Clarity
items/lenses-of-clarity.effectSummary: The lenses grant +4 insight on saves against charm, compulsion, and glamer spells and reduce miss chance from concealment created by a glamer by 10 percentage points.

items/coffin-hideaway.name: Coffin Hideaway
items/coffin-hideaway.effectSummary: When occupied, the coffin and everything inside shift to the Ethereal Plane; when empty, it remains on the Material Plane. The occupant can use a command word to return it to the Material Plane for 5 rounds, and entering or leaving takes a move-equivalent action.

items/horn-of-goodness-evil.name: Horn of Goodness/Evil
items/horn-of-goodness-evil.effectSummary: Once per day, a good owner can blow the horn to create magic circle against evil for 10 rounds, while an evil owner creates magic circle against good. A neutral owner gains no effect.

items/horseshoes-of-a-zephyr.name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
items/horseshoes-of-a-zephyr.effectSummary: With all four shoes fitted, a horse travels about 4 inches above a roughly horizontal surface at normal speed, allowing movement over water, lava, or unstable ground without leaving tracks.

items/scarab-golembane.name: Scarab, Golembane
items/scarab-golembane.effectSummary: By concentrating, the wearer can detect a designated type of golem within 60 feet. Against that golem type, the wearer's weapons and unarmed attacks ignore the golem's damage reduction.

items/healing-belt-500.name: Healing Belt
items/healing-belt-500.effectSummary: The belt continuously grants +2 competence on Heal checks and has 3 charges renewed each dawn. Spending 1, 2, or 3 charges on a touch heals 2d8, 3d8, or 4d8 hit points, or deals the same positive-energy damage to undead.

items/sea-steeds-bridle.name: Sea-steed's Bridle
items/sea-steeds-bridle.effectSummary: On command, the bridle transforms a ride-trained animal or magical beast into an aquatic form as steed of the seas; a second command restores normal form. The bridle resizes to fit any creature and does not require a paladin's special mount.

items/well-of-many-worlds.name: Well of Many Worlds
items/well-of-many-worlds.effectSummary: Unfolded like a portable hole, the well becomes a two-way portal to another world, planet, or plane chosen by the DM or randomly. Moving and reopening it causes the destination to be determined again, and objects or creatures can pass through from either side.

items/exploding-spike-399.name: Exploding Spike
items/exploding-spike-399.effectSummary: Planting the spike is a standard action; 1 round later it becomes invisible. The first creature to come within 10 feet triggers a 20-foot-radius fireball for 10d6 fire damage (Reflex DC 14 half), destroying the spike; while still visible, it can be safely removed as a standard action and reused.

items/chasuble-of-fell-power.name: Chasuble of Fell Power
items/chasuble-of-fell-power.effectSummary: The chasuble adds +1d6 damage in its lesser form or +2d6 in its greater form to the wearer's eldritch blast, or to any hit-point-damaging spell the wearer casts with the chaotic descriptor.

items/oars-of-speed.name: Oars of Speed
items/oars-of-speed.effectSummary: A vessel using the oars gains +10 feet enhancement to its speed. The bonus does not increase from extra pairs, and vessels that normally require more than two oars must equip all oar positions with oars of speed to gain the benefit.

items/crimson-dragonhide-bracers.name: Crimson Dragonhide Bracers
items/crimson-dragonhide-bracers.effectSummary: The bracers grant +1 to +5 enhancement to the wearer's natural armor, depending on the version, and also provide fire resistance 5.

items/triton-shell.name: Triton Shell
items/triton-shell.effectSummary: The shell keeps its contents perfectly dry and protected from ocean pressure without hindering the wearer's swimming. Some versions also contain a breathable air space, allowing Tiny or smaller air-breathing creatures to survive inside.

items/life-ring-419.name: Life Ring
items/life-ring-419.effectSummary: Breaking the twine activates the ring for 10 rounds. The next four creatures to touch it gain feather fall, each for the number of rounds remaining in the ring's duration when touched; afterward the ring becomes inert.

items/goggles-golden-sun-228.name: Goggles of the Golden Sun
items/goggles-golden-sun-228.effectSummary: The wearer is continuously immune to blindness and dazzling. Three times per day, the wearer can sacrifice a prepared spell or spell slot of 3rd level or higher to cast fireball (Reflex DC 14 half) using the higher of the wearer's caster level or the goggles' caster level.

items/breastplate-terror-175.name: Breastplate of Terror
items/breastplate-terror-175.effectSummary: The breastplate's damage reduction stacks with damage reduction gained as a class feature. Once per day immediately after a melee attack damages the wearer, the armor can make that attacker frightened for 1 round, or shaken instead on a successful DC 20 Will save.

items/yornars-crescent.name: Yornar's Crescent
items/yornars-crescent.effectSummary: The crescent can use detect poison and faerie fire at will, and can use greater magic fang and tree stride each once per day.

items/night-caller.name: Night Caller
items/night-caller.effectSummary: Once per week at night or in darkness, blowing the whistle over a grave animates one corpse as a loyal zombie. The whistle can maintain no more than two zombie followers at a time.

items/demondoom-403.name: Demondoom
items/demondoom-403.effectSummary: This +2 holy demon-bane cold-iron warhammer can make one blinding strike per day against a demon. Declare before attacking; on a hit, a 1d20+15 level check must overcome spell resistance or the demon is blinded as by power word blind. A miss or use against a nondemon wastes the daily strike.
